enabled.description: Enable SGE job polling for the GLOBUS_GRAM job manager. Required for SGE integration.

poll_interval.description: Seconds between polling cycles for job state updates.

max_jobs_per_poll.description: Maximum number of jobs to query per poll. Reduce on large clusters to avoid overload.

qmaster_host.description: Hostname or FQDN of the SGE qmaster server. Must be reachable by the Globus service.

cell_name.description: SGE cell name (e.g., 'default' or custom cell name used in your cluster).

sgeroot.description: Root directory of the SGE installation on the Globus host (used for binary discovery and environment setup).

sge_bin.description: Directory containing SGE binaries (qstat, qacct, etc.). Adjust for architecture (e.g., 'lx-arm64', 'solaris-x64').

qstat_path.description: Full path to qstat binary. Leave empty to auto-detect using sgeroot and sge_bin.

qacct_path.description: Full path to qacct binary. Leave empty to auto-detect using sgeroot and sge_bin.

exec_hosts.description: List of execution hostnames to restrict polling to. Empty list means poll all hosts.

verbose_job_status.description: Log detailed SGE job state (e.g., 'running', 'suspended') to debug log. May increase log size.

job_state_cache_file.description: Path to cache file storing job states between restarts. Must be writable by the Globus user.

job_state_cache_ttl.description: Time-to-live (seconds) for cached job state. Avoid setting too low to prevent excessive polling.

use_pe_info.description: Include SGE parallel environment (PE) info (e.g., slots requested) in job attributes. Required for multi-slot jobs.

resource_limits.description: List of SGE resource limits to expose as GLOBUS_GRAM job attributes (e.g., h_vmem → Memory in MB).

name.description: SGE resource name (e.g., h_vmem, h_cpu, s_cpu).

type.description: Type of resource value as exposed to Globus (e.g., 'string', 'integer').

globus_attr.description: Globus job attribute name to map the SGE resource to (e.g., 'Memory', 'CPUTime').

enable_cleanup.description: If true, kill orphaned SGE jobs when GLOBUS_GRAM job status is FAILED. Use with caution — may affect external job tracking.

max_concurrent_polls.description: Maximum number of simultaneous polling operations. Higher values may improve responsiveness but increase SGE load.
